question: Who's scored the most goals in the last 30 days?
reference_sql: select p.short_name as player, t.short_name as team, count(*) as goals, count(*) filter (where g.is_penalty) as penalties from goals g join players p on p.player_id = g.player_id join matches m on m.match_id = g.match_id join teams t on t.team_id = g.scoring_team_id where m.kickoff_at >= now() - interval '30 days' and not g.is_own_goal group by p.short_name, t.short_name order by goals desc, player limit 15
correct_behavior: Names the top scorers with team and goal count for the last 30 days, says own goals and goals without a known scorer are excluded

question: Which teams are in the best form right now?
reference_sql: with team_results as ( select home_team_id as team_id, home_goals as scored, away_goals as conceded, kickoff_at from matches where is_finished union all select away_team_id, away_goals, home_goals, kickoff_at from matches where is_finished ) select t.short_name as team, count(*) as played, sum(case when r.scored > r.conceded then 3 when r.scored = r.conceded then 1 else 0 end) as points, sum(r.scored) as goals_for, sum(r.conceded) as goals_against from team_results r join teams t on t.team_id = r.team_id where r.kickoff_at >= now() - interval '30 days' group by t.short_name order by points desc, sum(r.scored) - sum(r.conceded) desc
correct_behavior: Ranks teams by points from matches in the last 30 days, shows played/points/goal difference, says how many matches the form is based on

question: How strong are the opponents on the next matchday?
reference_sql: select m.matchday, m.kickoff_at at time zone 'Europe/Berlin' as kickoff_german_time, home.short_name as home_team, hs.position as home_position, hs.points as home_points, away.short_name as away_team, aws.position as away_position, aws.points as away_points, aws.position - hs.position as position_gap from matches m join teams home on home.team_id = m.home_team_id join teams away on away.team_id = m.away_team_id join standings hs on hs.team_id = m.home_team_id and hs.season = m.season join standings aws on aws.team_id = m.away_team_id and aws.season = m.season where m.season = 2026 and m.matchday = (select min(matchday) from matches where season = 2026 and not is_finished) order by m.kickoff_at
correct_behavior: Lists every match of the next unfinished matchday with both teams' table position and points, kickoff in German time

question: Have Upamecano, Burkardt, Nmecha, Caci, Mwene, Khedira or Poreba scored this season?
reference_sql: select p.short_name as player, m.matchday, home.short_name || ' - ' || away.short_name as match, g.minute, g.is_penalty from goals g join players p on p.player_id = g.player_id join matches m on m.match_id = g.match_id join teams home on home.team_id = m.home_team_id join teams away on away.team_id = m.away_team_id where m.season = 2026 and not g.is_own_goal and (p.short_name ilike '%Upamecano%' or p.short_name ilike '%Burkardt%' or p.short_name ilike '%Nmecha%' or p.short_name ilike '%Caci%' or p.short_name ilike '%Mwene%' or p.short_name ilike '%Khedira%' or p.short_name ilike '%Poreba%') order by p.short_name, m.matchday
correct_behavior: Lists each of these players' goals with matchday, match and minute; players with no goals are named as having none (not as unknown)

question: Who's at the bottom of the table and how far behind the leader?
reference_sql: select s.position, t.short_name as team, s.matches_played, s.won, s.draw, s.lost, s.goals_for || ':' || s.goals_against as goals, s.points, lead.points - s.points as points_behind_leader from standings s join teams t on t.team_id = s.team_id join standings lead on lead.season = s.season and lead.position = 1 where s.season = 2026 order by s.position desc limit 6
correct_behavior: Shows the bottom 6 with record, goals, points and gap to first place; mentions Gladbach's position

question: When in a match are most goals scored?
reference_sql: select case when minute is null then 'unknown' when minute <= 15 then '01-15' when minute <= 30 then '16-30' when minute <= 45 then '31-45' when minute <= 60 then '46-60' when minute <= 75 then '61-75' when minute <= 90 then '76-90' else '90+' end as minute_block, count(*) as goals, round(100.0 * count(*) / sum(count(*)) over (), 1) as percent_of_all_goals from goals group by minute_block order by minute_block
correct_behavior: Gives goals and percent per 15-minute block, names 76-90 as the biggest block (or whatever the query returns), mentions goals with unknown minute

question: Who does Gladbach play next and how good are they?
reference_sql: select m.matchday, m.kickoff_at at time zone 'Europe/Berlin' as kickoff_german_time, home.short_name as home_team, away.short_name as away_team, os.position as opponent_position, os.points as opponent_points from matches m join teams home on home.team_id = m.home_team_id join teams away on away.team_id = m.away_team_id join standings os on os.season = m.season and os.team_id = case when home.short_name = 'Gladbach' then m.away_team_id else m.home_team_id end where m.season = 2026 and not m.is_finished and 'Gladbach' in (home.short_name, away.short_name) order by m.kickoff_at limit 1
correct_behavior: Names the next opponent, home or away, kickoff date, and the opponent's current position and points

question: Is Burkardt scoring more this season than last season?
reference_sql: select m.season, count(*) as goals, count(distinct m.match_id) as matches_with_goal from goals g join players p on p.player_id = g.player_id join matches m on m.match_id = g.match_id where p.short_name ilike '%Burkardt%' and not g.is_own_goal group by m.season order by m.season
correct_behavior: Compares goals in 2025 (full season) and 2026 (so far) and points out that 2026 is not finished, ideally per matchday played

question: How many goals has Bayern scored on each of the last 5 matchdays?
reference_sql: select m.matchday, home.short_name || ' - ' || away.short_name as match, case when m.home_team_id = t.team_id then m.home_goals else m.away_goals end as bayern_goals from matches m join teams t on t.short_name = 'Bayern' join teams home on home.team_id = m.home_team_id join teams away on away.team_id = m.away_team_id where m.season = 2026 and m.is_finished and t.team_id in (m.home_team_id, m.away_team_id) order by m.matchday desc limit 5
correct_behavior: Lists the last 5 finished Bayern matches with opponent and Bayern's goals, newest first

question: What does the top of the table look like?

question: How did Bayern and Dortmund do against each other in the last two seasons?
reference_sql: select m.season, m.matchday, home.short_name || ' - ' || away.short_name as match, m.home_goals || ':' || m.away_goals as result from matches m join teams home on home.team_id = m.home_team_id join teams away on away.team_id = m.away_team_id where m.is_finished and home.short_name in ('Bayern','Dortmund') and away.short_name in ('Bayern','Dortmund') order by m.kickoff_at
correct_behavior: Lists every finished Bayern-Dortmund match in 2025 and 2026 with result; does not invent older matches

question: Who has scored the most penalties this season?
reference_sql: select p.short_name as player, t.short_name as team, count(*) as penalties from goals g join players p on p.player_id = g.player_id join matches m on m.match_id = g.match_id left join teams t on t.team_id = g.scoring_team_id where m.season = 2026 and g.is_penalty and not g.is_own_goal group by p.short_name, t.short_name order by penalties desc, player limit 10
correct_behavior: Names the players with most penalty goals in 2026/27 with counts; only scored penalties (missed ones are not in the data)

question: How up to date is your data?

question: Do home teams win more often this season?
reference_sql: select count(*) as finished_matches, round(100.0 * count(*) filter (where home_goals > away_goals) / count(*), 1) as pct_home_wins, round(100.0 * count(*) filter (where home_goals = away_goals) / count(*), 1) as pct_draws, round(100.0 * count(*) filter (where home_goals < away_goals) / count(*), 1) as pct_away_wins from matches where season = 2026 and is_finished
correct_behavior: Gives home win, draw and away win percentages for finished 2026/27 matches and the number of matches
